summary: Delphine's Flashback is a rotoscoped cinematic platformer preserved through the 25th-anniversary release, older computer/console ports, and remake/sequel comparison routes.

entries.title: Flashback
entries.definitive_edition: Flashback 25th-anniversary release, using original mode where possible

emulation.emulator: None for primary; platform emulators only for original-port comparison
emulation.notes: Use the modern official release first; document exact original port if comparing.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Amiga/DOS/console hardware for port-specific authenticity; 25th-anniversary release for current access

primary.why: The 2018 25th-anniversary release includes the original game plus modern mode options, making it the practical current route. Original Amiga, DOS, Genesis/Mega Drive, and Sega CD-era ports differ in audio, cutscenes, controls, and timing.
primary.how_to_play: Use the 25th-anniversary release on PC or console. Record platform/build, original versus modern mode, filters, rewind/tutorial use, difficulty, level, password/save state, and whether the 2013 remake or Flashback 2 was excluded.

secondary.platform: Amiga / DOS / Genesis / Sega CD / SNES
secondary.exclusive_content: Original-era version differences in audio, cutscenes, timing, and controls
secondary.why: The modern release is convenient, but original ports are not identical.

secondary.what_to_play: Archive separately or label as comparison only.
secondary.why: They are not the 1992 game route.

all_releases.platform: Amiga / MS-DOS / Genesis and other original ports

all_releases.fidelity: Current official route with original game and modern options.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Original-era ports, the 25th-anniversary wrapper, and the 2013 remake are different artifacts.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record original/modern mode, filters, rewind, tutorial, and platform.
